limits: Owned temporary git repository and fake gh first-later-effect sentinel only. Measures opt-in readiness refusal before issue reads, fetches, claims or worktree creation; healthy and standalone lanes deliberately stop at the fake provider. Does not authenticate, fetch from a network, install, or measure arbitrary host effects. The constructed anchor accepts the flag but removes enforcement, reaching the forbidden seam on every adverse report.
